source_units.text: Explain a shelving exception in an invented collection.
The intended readers are volunteer catalogers in a fictional reading collection.
Include the following invented details: The Atlas of Knots belongs on the craft shelf despite its atlas title because all its pages teach tying techniques.
Add a shelf note under geography so title-based searches still lead to it.
Preserve these exact phrases: "The Atlas of Knots", "craft shelf", "shelf note".
